description: This file defines the LoanInterestPaymentWaiverCommandHandler class, which handles commands related to interest payment waivers on loans in the Fineract system. It implements the command handling logic, delegating to a service to perform the waiver operation.

classes.name: LoanInterestPaymentWaiverCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the interest payment waiver commands for loans, applying the waiver through the LoanWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the interest payment waiver command by delegating to the LoanWritePlatformService's makeInterestPaymentWaiver method.
